title: The Cutting Edge Conquest report

# **The Cutting Edge Conquest **

_This post is related to the previous thread posted here :_ 
[https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/5848-the-cutting-edge-conquest-a-community-campaigns-series-partially-postpaid](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/5848-the-cutting-edge-conquest-a-community-campaigns-series-partially-postpaid)

**Overview: The Cutting Edge Conquest was designed to be a series of community campaigns to raise awareness of the Edgeware ecosystem across a variety of platforms. This event was comprised of five community campaigns.**

1. **Edgeware Weekly Quiz (5 Quizzes)**
2. **Twitter Meme Contests**
3. **Sticker Competition**
4. **Reels/Shorts Competition (Few participants resulted in the event being canceled)**
5. **Discord Games**


**Total amount in EDG: 480,000**
**Total Spent in EDG : 384,520**
**The remaining 95,480 $EDG will be carried on to the next upcoming event **

**	Number of participants: 28**

**	Total distribution : 84,520 $EDG**
**	Event Period : July 10th - July 20th**
